description: This file defines an abstract class 'TypeResolver' with methods for resolving a type from its string name, including methods for both strict resolution (throwing exceptions on failure) and safe resolution (returning success status).

classes.name: TypeResolver
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to resolve a System.Type from a string within the Orleans.Serialization.TypeSystem namespace.

methods.name: ResolveType
methods.description: Abstract method to resolve a type by name, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: TryResolveType
methods.description: Abstract method to resolve a type by name, returning a boolean indicating success or failure.
